# currency code

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:currencyCode`](gmeow-currencyCode.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/currencyCode>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

The canonical short code of a currency reference frame (a member of [`gmeow:frameRealmCurrency`](../individuals/gmeow-frameRealmCurrency.md)) — the ISO 4217 alphabetic code for fiat currencies (USD, EUR, CAD …) and the conventional ticker for cryptocurrencies (BTC, ETH). Functional: one canonical code per frame. Lets a currency project to [schema:currenciesAccepted](https://schema.org/currenciesAccepted) and other code-bearing consumer terms.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md) -> [`xsd:string`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string); functional
